svg.title: One source, two observers — execution at step 25, 130 ms
svg.desc: A fixed pipeline graph and four synchronized lanes: time, source notifications, internal reactions, and resulting notifications. Dashed glyphs identify modelled explanations; solid glyphs identify observed events. Events at one time retain their sequence order. Subscription endings distinguish completion from cancellation.

g.aria-label: Inspect Cold source. A at 0, B at 50, C at 100, Complete due at 150. Sharing creates exactly one upstream execution.. unsubscribe · cancelled. Values enter here
g.title: Cold source: A at 0, B at 50, C at 100, Complete due at 150. Sharing creates exactly one upstream execution.

g.aria-label: Inspect share(explicitPolicy). A Subject distributes one upstream execution. No replay. Reset and disconnect when the final subscriber leaves.. state. subscriberCount=0 · upstream=disconnect
g.title: share(explicitPolicy): A Subject distributes one upstream execution. No replay. Reset and disconnect when the final subscriber leaves.

g.aria-label: Inspect Observer A. Subscribes at 0; receives A and B; cancels at 90 ms.. unsubscribe · cancelled. Subscriber receives
g.title: Observer A: Subscribes at 0; receives A and B; cancels at 90 ms.

g.aria-label: Inspect Observer B. Subscribes at 40; receives B and C; cancels at 130 ms. The earlier A is not replayed.. unsubscribe · cancelled. Subscriber receives
g.title: Observer B: Subscribes at 40; receives B and C; cancels at 130 ms. The earlier A is not replayed.

g.text: Solid = observed · dashed = modelled · # = step order
